name: status is a flat map whose keys contain literal dots
description: Feeds Phorge's cluster notification panel, which reads these off the top level with idx($details, 'clients.active'). The dots are part of the key names, not a nesting convention: nesting them would leave the panel with nothing to show, and it is this response that made contracttest's path walker try a whole dotted segment as a literal key before splitting on dots.
